title: Format pages
description: The record format's pages in the wiki card over the stage: the format itself (the concepts, the kinds by stage, the relations and the checks by severity, with Add a check), a kind's page and a check's page (its body the Check aggregate's own, CheckPage), opened by `?page=format/...` on the current address while the stage keeps its focus.

title: Format reference
description: The data and links behind the format pages: every kind, relation, stage and check of the current space, read from the schema served with the data and the check table's rows, and the `?page=format/...` links that open them in the wiki card.

title: Desktop record actions
description: In the desktop app only, Reveal, Open in editor and Copy ID buttons beside a record's data file in its facts, and the same three in the shell's native menu on a right-click on a record row, a graph box or the page title; it also sends the product's error count to the Dock badge.

title: Shared spec parts
description: The shared spec parts and TestStateTag.

title: Mentions
description: A record's text field rendered as Markdown, with each ID it names that is a record of the current space, other than the record itself, turned into a link to that record; every text field on a record's page uses it.

title: Flow steps
description: A flow's steps on the Use case page as one table per path, the main path first, read from the use case whole: each row the step's order, ID and title and the IDs it links to, what they are folded under the row.

title: Graph motion
description: The speed and easing every animation shares, read from the stylesheet's `--motion-speed` and `--motion-ease` tokens and turned off under reduced motion; the Graph and ERD stages' cameras glide on it.

title: Tab strip
description: The desktop app's tabs, at the left of the page bar; the web app has no tab strip (LA-V96-R32).

title: ERD layout
description: Places the ERD stage's boxes with ELK's layered algorithm in three passes (each aggregate's entities, each domain's aggregates, then the domains), once per product and data change, so every focus and stage switch on the same data shows the same picture.

title: ERD stage
description: The ERD stage: the product's, the domain's or the aggregate's diagram fitted in the open space, the focus's nearest box highlighted, with its key floating at its foot.

title: Tap to open
description: On the Graph and ERD stages' canvas under a finger, a first tap selects a box, outlining it and naming it in a card at the bottom of the canvas, and a second tap or a tap on the card opens it; a mouse click still opens at once.

title: Edge hints
description: Small chips at each edge of a canvas counting the boxes of interest past it ("3 ↑"); a click pans the camera that way by about half the canvas, without changing the focus.

title: Requirement groups
description: Sorts a page's terms, requirements, interaction requirements, pattern rules and standard rules by their `group_name`: the ungrouped first with no heading, then each group under its heading in the order it first appears, compared trimmed and in any letter case.

title: Graph shapes
description: A shape for each kind: a box's outline in the Graph stage's Tree view, and a small mark before the kind and ID line in the Nested and Voronoi views and the key; each keeps a rectangular footprint and a clear area for its label.

title: Graph painter
description: Draws the Graph and Trace stages' canvas each frame from the map's plates: lines under the boxes, each label at its map size times the zoom (a line too small on screen as a faint bar), the focus ring, the hover spotlight, the focus fade and the live changes' marks.

title: Box plates
description: A box as the Graph stage's canvas draws it, made once per map and node: its outline (its kind's shape in Tree, a box in Nested, a cell in Voronoi), its colors' roles, and its label's lines, marks and problem badges placed in map units.

title: Graph text faces
description: Loads the theme's body and mono faces before the Graph stage's first layout and measures text with the canvas's own metrics, in the page and in the Voronoi worker alike, so every label line fits its box at any zoom.

title: Graph look
description: The colors and opacities the Graph stage's canvas draws with, read from the stylesheet's tokens through a probe element and read again when the theme changes, so the canvas follows light and dark like the rest of the page.

title: Hit testing
description: Finds the box under the pointer on the Graph stage's canvas from the map's own outlines (a rectangle, a polygon, rounded corners or a Voronoi cell), testing the last drawn first so a child over its parent is found before it.

title: ERD edge hints
description: The edge hint chips over the ERD stage's React Flow canvas, counting the boxes in focus past each edge through React Flow's camera and drawn again only when a count changes.

title: Lathe logo
description: Lathe's logo in the page's steel and spark colors.

title: Actions slot
description: The place in a heading's row where a list's controls sit.

title: Line icons
description: The line icons drawn inline, with no icon font.

title: ERD icon
description: The ERD stage's icon in the stage switch.

title: Shape marks
description: The small marks of a kind's shape, in the boxes and the key.

title: Quick pick
description: A filter box over a list, as the theme picker shows it.

title: FieldsTable
description: The fields of an entity, a value object, a domain event or a read model as their aggregates' pages show them: name, meaning, type (a basic type, a value object or a reference to an aggregate), whether required, column and example.

title: Focus fade
description: How strongly the graph draws each box for its focus: the focus's subtree at full strength, the trail and the rest faded.

title: Trace stage
description: The Trace stage: the canvas over the table, its Gaps only switch, its note and the keyboard's Show more floating at the top of the open space; on a phone, the table alone.

title: Card
description: The one card: a title that is its link or button, stretched over the whole card, and what else the card holds; and the grid that lists cards.

title: Header strip
description: The focus's one line: its breadcrumb, kind, ID and title, and what the stage draws of it. Under the page bar in the desktop app; on the web, wide, the tab panel's one row, as high as a page bar, holding the page's controls (the stage switch and the wiki card toggle) at its right, after the counts.

title: Breadcrumb
description: The one trail of places above a page, collapsed past three places with a menu of the hidden levels.

title: Open space
description: The stage's measure of what the floating panels leave of it, as CSS variables and a store the stages frame their focus in and report where they framed it, for the wiki card.

title: Wiki card
description: The focus's wiki page as a callout in the map, floating over the right of the open space, in one spot just under the stage's toolbar row and a steady share of the stage high: its breadcrumb, kind line, title, summary or whole page (More and Less), its collapse button and resize handle.

title: Trace canvas
description: The Trace stage drawn on the canvas as the Graph's Tree is, with the graph's painter, camera and level of detail: what is in view of the product's tree, an arrow for each link of a chain, the hover spotlight over every copy of a record, and the keyboard's ring.

title: Trace tree
description: The Trace stage's tree, laid out once by the Graph's Tree layout: below the top, each obligation's gaps and its chain to its right by the chain's links in each place it sits, the Untraced mark's records, a use case's capability on its kind line and every repeated record's count; where a focus stands (a capability on the first copy of its first use case) and what it and Gaps only keep at full strength.

title: Chat panel
description: The chat panel: its head (with the Bypass badge), the Lathe tools note and the mode control under it, the session picker with the not-found and not-signed-in messages, the log with its tool rows, permission prompts (Allow once, Allow always in this chat, Deny) and record diffs, the focus chip and the composer.

title: ChangeDetails
description: One record's change from the engine's record diff (LA-EXP-QRY13, lathe/src/changes.ts): each changed field old → new, each part row added, removed or changed, and the links added and removed, as the chat's turn changes, the Changes panel's cards and the wiki card's Changes section show it.

title: useChat
description: The chat as the panel keeps it: the items and status the shell sends as patches, and each turn with the spec as it was when the turn began, which the record diffs compare.

title: ErdLeader
description: The ERD's canvas over React Flow's boxes that draws the leader line to the wiki card from the focused box.

title: erdStep
description: The ERD stage's arrow walk: the nearest box in the arrow's direction on the map, within the focus's own area first.

title: traceLevels
description: The Trace stage's walk over its tree by the Graph's Tree keys: Left out, Right in, Up and Down across, each copy of a record in its own place; and what the walk says on each box.

title: ToolPanelFrame
description: The one frame of a tool over the stage: a frosted panel at the left of the open space, a bottom sheet on a phone.

title: RecordHistory
description: The History section at the end of the expanded wiki card: the "Show the history" button, then the record's commits, the uncommitted change first, each with its diff, and Load more.

title: ChecksPanel
description: The Checks panel over the stage: the space's problems by check, errors first, then the workspace's, read through the Problems read (list-problems).

title: ProductsPicker
description: The products picker: a card of every product, centered over the last product's dimmed stage.

title: StageKey
description: Every stage's key: a frosted bar along the bottom of the open space, between the camera and the minimap, each entry a sample and a word or two with its meaning as its tooltip, fed by the stage's own entries and the live marks; wrapping to as many rows as it needs, every entry whole; on a phone a Key chip that opens a sheet.

title: StageToolbar
description: Every stage's chrome: the toolbar at the top of the open space (the steps, Out, In and Frame, the Changes controls, the stage's own controls, and the More menu its narrower forms fold groups into, in the order TOOLBAR_FORMS pins) and the camera's zoom in, zoom out and fit at the frame's bottom left (StageCamera).

title: traceKeyEntries
description: The Trace stage's key entries, for every stage's key bar: the stage colors of the records the tree draws, link, file, gap and Untraced boxes, the chain's arrows and the parents' plain lines, the focus, the fades and Gaps only's Complete, each only while the tree draws it at full strength under the focus.

title: ChangesPanel
description: The Changes panel over the stage: the baseline picker, then the changed records newest first, each a card.

title: ChangesTools
description: Every stage's Changes controls in the shared stage toolbar, after Frame: the Changes lens, the baseline picker, Follow and the Changes panel's toggle with its count.

title: CardChanges
description: The wiki card's Changes section, or "New since <baseline>" on an added record.

title: ChangesKey
description: The live marks and the Changes lens in every stage's key.

title: ChangesProvider
description: Keeps the space's changes for every stage, the wiki card and the Changes panel: the baseline picked, the record diff against it, the live marks of each reload, the lens and Follow.

title: graphKeyEntries
description: The Graph stage's key entries, for every stage's key bar: each stage color, shape, mark, line and badge the graph draws around its focus, the kinds the filters hide left out.

title: traceTop
description: The top of the Trace stage's tree, one small children rule kept apart from the layout, chains, walk and painting: from the product down to each obligation, under each business outcome the use cases of the capabilities serving it (no capability drawn; a use case under several outcomes in each) and their requirements, then the Not under an outcome branch holding every obligation no outcome reaches by domain, and the Untraced mark last.

title: UseCasePage
description: The Use case page: a record of a use case, from the use case read whole, by the kind it is in it (goal, actors, flows by interface and requirements; a requirement's statement and the steps that fulfill it; a flow's interface and steps; a step's links; a test's scenario), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: UseCaseEditor
description: The Use case page's actions and forms: Edit, Add, Move and Remove, each sending one of the Use case aggregate's own commands (POST /api/use-case/<command>), built from the shared field inputs, with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason.

title: ColumnField
description: The shared field inputs every editor builds its fields from: one per column type (ColumnField), a record's ID (IdField) or a list of them (IdsField), a list of a part table's rows (PartsField), with their label, description, problem and the refusal at the top of a form.

title: ProductPage
description: The Product page: a product, an open question or an interface, from the product's page read whole, by the kind it is (a product's outcomes, domains, shared records, summary, roles, interfaces, declarations, questions and problems; a question's owner, place and what it is about; an interface's flows by capability), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: ProductEditor
description: The Product page's actions and forms: Edit, Add, Declare, each declaration's Change and Remove, Move (an open question) and Remove, each sending one of the Product aggregate's own commands (POST /api/product/<command>), built from the shared field inputs, each refusal shown with every reason.

title: BusinessOutcomePage
description: The Business outcome page: an outcome's statement, measure, target, measure outside the code and notes, from its page read through its own query, inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: BusinessOutcomeEditor
description: The Business outcome page's actions and forms: Edit and Remove on an outcome, and Add a business outcome from its product's page, each sending one of the aggregate's own commands, each refusal shown with every reason.

title: ExtensionRecordPage
description: The Extension record page: a record of a product's own kind, its lead text and declared fields, links by relation and packages, from its page read through its own query, inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: ExtensionRecordEditor
description: The Extension record page's actions and forms, built from the record's kind's declaration: Edit and Remove, and Add a record of a kind from its parent's page, each sending one of the aggregate's own commands, each refusal shown with every reason.

title: EntryPointPage
description: The Entry point page: what an entry point does at start-up, its file, packages and the standard rules it meets, from its page read through its own query, inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: EntryPointEditor
description: The Entry point page's actions and forms: Edit and Remove, and Add an entry point from its domain's page, each sending one of the aggregate's own commands, each refusal shown with every reason.

title: ToolingPage
description: The Tooling page: a tooling record's file, packages and the standard rules it meets, from its page read through its own query, inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: ToolingEditor
description: The Tooling page's actions and forms: Edit and Remove, and Add a tooling record from its domain's page, each sending one of the aggregate's own commands, each refusal shown with every reason.

title: DomainPage
description: The Domain page: a record of a domain, from the domain read whole, by the kind it is in it (the domain's wiki; a capability's description and use cases; a term's meaning; a domain service's statement, service and tests; a repository's description and the aggregates it also persists; a test's scenario), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: DomainEditor
description: The Domain page's actions and forms: Edit, Add and Remove, each sending one of the Domain aggregate's own commands (POST /api/domain/<command>), and Add of another aggregate's root that sits under the record through its own Add form, built from the shared field inputs, with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason.

title: TestDataSetPage
description: The Test data set page: a test data set from its page read, its description, environment, accounts, starting records, preparation and reset inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: TestDataSetEditor
description: The Test data set page's actions and forms: Edit and Remove, and the Add form a domain's page opens, each sending one of the Test data set aggregate's own commands (POST /api/test-data-set/<command>), with each refusal shown with every reason.

title: PatternPage
description: The Pattern page: a record of a pattern, from the pattern read whole (its settings, its rules under their groups, a rule's statement, a test's scenario), with Pattern following's Followed by and Owed by in their place, inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: PatternEditor
description: The Pattern page's actions and forms: Edit (a pattern's settings as a list of rows), Add and Remove, each sending one of the Pattern aggregate's own commands (POST /api/pattern/<command>), with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason.

title: StandardPage
description: The Standard page: a record of a standard, from the standard read whole (its rules in a table under their groups with what meets each and its tests, a rule's statement, a test's scenario), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: StandardEditor
description: The Standard page's actions and forms: Edit, Add and Remove, each sending one of the Standard aggregate's own commands (POST /api/standard/<command>), with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason.

title: Page parts
description: The pieces an aggregate's page draws its records with: a text as Markdown under its heading or as the lead, short facts, rows that each lead to a record, a test's scenario and what it starts from, the wiki card's summary, and what the page shows while its read is under way or refused.

title: CommandForm
description: The form an aggregate's editor sends one command from: its heading, its fields from the shared field inputs in the order the editor gives, Save and Cancel, the command's refusal with every reason at its top; and the remove question that names what goes with a record. It knows no kind and no command.

title: AggregatePage
description: The Aggregate page: a record of an aggregate, from the aggregate read whole, by the kind it is in it (the aggregate's description, identity, entities, invariants and its domain events with what raises and hears each; an entity's description, fields, data model and commands; an invariant's statement, rule and test; a test's scenario), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: AggregateEditor
description: The Aggregate page's actions and forms: Edit (an entity's fields as a list of rows), Add and Remove, each sending one of the Aggregate aggregate's own commands (POST /api/aggregate/<command>), the Add form a domain's page opens, and Add of a domain event or a command through its own aggregate's Add form, built from the shared field inputs, with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason.

title: DomainEventPage
description: The Domain event page: a domain event or its event type, from the event read whole (the event's description, the fields it carries and its event type), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: DomainEventEditor
description: The Domain event page's actions and forms: Edit (an event's fields as a list of rows), Add an event type and Remove, each sending one of the Domain event aggregate's own commands (POST /api/domain-event/<command>), and the Add form an aggregate's page opens, with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason.

title: CommandPage
description: The Command page: a record of a command, from the command read whole, by the kind it is in it (the command's description, handler, policies, the endpoints that expose it and what else it changes; a policy's statement, event handler and test; a handler's description; a test's scenario), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: CommandEditor
description: The Command page's actions and forms: Edit, Add and Remove, each sending one of the Command aggregate's own commands (POST /api/command/<command>), and the Add form an entity's page opens, built from the shared field inputs, with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason.

title: TablePage
description: The Table page: a record of a table, from the table read whole, inside the Record page's frame, with its summary for the wiki card.

title: TableEditor
description: The Table page's actions and forms: Edit, Add, Move and Remove, each sending one of the Table aggregate's own commands (POST /api/table/<command>), with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason; and the Add form of a table from the page it sits under.

title: SpecificationPage
description: The Specification page: a record of a specification, its predicate or its test, from the specification read whole, inside the Record page's frame, with its summary for the wiki card.

title: SpecificationEditor
description: The Specification page's actions and forms: Edit, Add and Remove, each sending one of the Specification aggregate's own commands (POST /api/specification/<command>), with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason; and the Add form of a specification from the page it sits under.

title: ValueObjectPage
description: The Value object page: a record of a value object, a constraint, its value type or a constraint test, from the value object read whole, inside the Record page's frame, with its summary for the wiki card.

title: ValueObjectEditor
description: The Value object page's actions and forms: Edit, Add and Remove, each sending one of the Value object aggregate's own commands (POST /api/value-object/<command>), with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason; and the Add form of a value object from the page it sits under.

title: ReadModelPage
description: The Read model page: a record of a read model, a query, its projection, its reader or a query handler, from the read model read whole, inside the Record page's frame, with its summary for the wiki card.

title: ReadModelEditor
description: The Read model page's actions and forms: Edit, Add and Remove, each sending one of the Read model aggregate's own commands (POST /api/read-model/<command>), with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason; and the Add form of a read model from the page it sits under.

title: ViewPage
description: The View page: a record of a view, from the view read whole (its requirements in a table under their groups with the tests that prove each, a requirement's statement, a test's scenario), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: ViewEditor
description: The View page's actions and forms: Edit, Add and Remove, and Add a view from its product's page, each sending one of the View aggregate's own commands (POST /api/view/<command>), with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason.

title: UiComponentPage
description: The UI component page: a UI component, from its read whole (its description and the packages it uses), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: UiComponentEditor
description: The UI component page's actions and forms: Edit and Remove, and Add a UI component from its product's page, each sending one of the UI component aggregate's own commands (POST /api/ui-component/<command>), with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason.

title: EndpointPage
description: The Endpoint page: a record of an endpoint, from the endpoint read whole (its description and notes, its handler, and its API requirements in a table under their groups with the tests that prove each; a requirement's statement, the handler's description and packages, a test's scenario), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: EndpointEditor
description: The Endpoint page's actions and forms: Edit, Add, Move (the endpoint only) and Remove, each sending one of the Endpoint aggregate's own commands (POST /api/endpoint/<command>), with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason; and Add an endpoint from its command's or query's page.

title: IntegrationPage
description: The Integration page: a record of an integration, from the integration read whole (its description, its adapter and its integration tests; the adapter's description and packages, a test's scenario), inside the Record page's frame, and its summary in the wiki card.

title: IntegrationEditor
description: The Integration page's actions and forms: Edit, Add and Remove, each sending one of the Integration aggregate's own commands (POST /api/integration/<command>), with the next free ID read from the aggregate and each refusal shown with every reason; and Add an integration from its product's page.

title: CheckPage
description: The Check page's body in the wiki card: a check with a row read whole through the Check aggregate's own query (its summary, explanation, severity, where it comes from, its place in the run order, its query and the kinds it concerns), a check the engine reports itself from the format reference, and the problems it reports now.

title: CheckEditor
description: The actions on a product's own check, each sending one of the Check aggregate's commands: Edit (Change a check, only what changed) and Remove on its page, and Add a check from the record format's Checks; Lathe's own checks show none.

title: LimitsSection
description: The Product page's Limits: the product's children and entities limits read through the Product setting aggregate's own query, its own or the defaults, said which.

title: LimitsEditor
description: Set limits on the Product page: the form that starts at the product's current limits and sends the Product setting aggregate's one command with both.

title: Followers
description: A pattern's Followed by and a rule's Owed by: each following domain read through the Pattern following aggregate's own query, with the whole domain's row and each following use case's, the values they give each setting, and the domain's standing per rule.

title: FollowingEditor
description: The following's actions, each sending one of the Pattern following aggregate's commands: on a follower's row, Change values (the whole list) and Stop following; under the followers, Follow for a domain or use case of the pattern's product.

title: StorageRequirementPage
description: The Storage requirement page: a record of the aggregate, from it read whole, inside the Record page's frame, with its summary for the wiki card.

title: StorageRequirementEditor
description: The page's actions and forms: Edit, Add and Remove, each sending one of the aggregate's own commands, built from the shared command form and field inputs.

title: DataStorePage
description: The Data store page: a record of the aggregate, from it read whole, inside the Record page's frame, with its summary for the wiki card.

title: DataStoreEditor
description: The page's actions and forms: Edit, Add and Remove, each sending one of the aggregate's own commands, built from the shared command form and field inputs.

title: AddMenu
description: The one Add control of every record's actions: one Add <kind> button when the record offers one kind, else one Add… menu listing the kinds, in the meta model's reading order, each opening its aggregate's own Add form.

title: Record folders
description: The folders a product's or domain's records are read in, for the nav, the domain page, the group pages and the graph: its stages, each with one folder per kind by the kind's stage in the schema, the records that start a branch of the stage, and what sits under a record in the same stage folded under it, each kind's records in their position order as numbers, then by ID.

title: Spec index
description: The app's index of the spec, built from the typed rows the server serves: a record per row with its parent, a link per relation row, and where a record with no owner sits (its product and the one domain that uses it, or none when shared), from the store's placements; every view reads it.

title: Graph tree
description: The graph's tree, the nav's: a product's Shared folder, its domains with their stages and folders, each record's children of its own stage under it, through one group per kind when they are of more than one kind; built once per index.

title: Graph neighborhood
description: The picture the camera frames around a record or group, by levels of the graph's tree and the kind filters: its nodes, each in its depth column, and the parent edges between them, with no follows link drawn.

title: Tree map
description: The graph's one map per product, laid out once per spec load as an icicle: each parent split equally among its children, who form a column of their own after it, share one width and one text size, and are joined to it by level parent lines; no size depends on the focus.

title: ServesFact
description: A record's Serves line among its facts: the outcomes it serves, each a link, read through get-serves; or that no use case reaches it, linking serves-no-outcome for an aggregate, read model or obligation.

title: ChatModeMenu
description: The chat's permission mode control: a button naming the mode that opens a menu of the five, each with what it lets Claude do, walked by the arrow keys; and the warning before Bypass is turned on.

title: Map morph
description: Glides what a new layout moved from its old place to its new one, on the shared motion, and keeps the camera where it was unless the focus itself moved; the Graph, the Trace and the ERD stages use it.

title: CoverageBars
description: CoverageBars, obligationGroups, ProductSummary, TestCountsLine, sumTestCounts

title: Traceability section
description: Traceability and its gap callouts, requirement table and run by.

title: DomainPatterns
description: DomainPatterns, RuleMarks: the patterns a domain follows with its standing per rule, and a rule's standing mark, which the Pattern page shows per following domain

title: linkLabel
description: linkLabel, relationLabelOf, groupByLabel

title: App shell
description: The whole window: the nav, the stage for the address with the wiki card, the tools and Appearance over it, the desktop title bar and chat panel, quick find and the command palette, and the commands that work everywhere.

title: Commands and shortcuts sheet
description: The command dispatcher, the dialog and keys every overlay shares, and the shortcuts sheet.

title: Tooltip
description: A control's short name and its shortcut keys from the keymap in a tooltip, shown after a short hover or at once on keyboard focus and closed on leaving, blur, a click or Escape; it also gives the control `aria-keyshortcuts`.

title: Resize handle
description: The vertical handle between two panels that resizes the one beside it by a drag, the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps), Home and End, and a double-click to reset; every resizable divider in the app uses it.

title: Page bar
description: The top of the tab panel in the desktop app and on a phone: in the desktop app the tabs (on a phone the Open pages button), then the page's controls (PageActions): the stage switch and the wiki card toggle. On the web, wide, there is no page bar: the controls sit at the right of the header strip's row.

title: Bottom sheet
description: On a phone, a sheet rising from the bottom edge to half the screen with a grab handle: a drag up or a tap takes it to full height, a drag down back to half or away, and Escape, a tap on the dimmed page or its close button dismisses it, focus staying inside while it is open.

title: Phone top bar
description: The phone top bar and the quick find sheet.

title: Shared styles
description: The app's one stylesheet: the theme tokens on `:root` (colors, stage colors, motion, type, touch sizes and panel spacing) and the styles of the shell, nav, stages, panels, wiki card and shared components.

title: Button
description: Every standalone action as one button: ghost by default, primary (filled with the accent) for a form's or dialog's main action, or a square icon button that must be given a name; it renders a real link styled as a button when it navigates.

title: Theme stylesheet
description: Writes a theme as the stylesheet it sets: its token values on `:root[data-theme]`, the light set always, and the dark set when the system is dark and Light is not chosen, or when Dark is chosen.

title: Early theme script
description: An inline script in `index.html`'s head that puts the stored theme stylesheet and the chosen light or dark mode on the page before first paint, so the page never flashes another theme.

title: Theme color
description: Keeps the page's `<meta name="theme-color">` on the theme's `--sheet` color, so the browser's own chrome (a phone's status bar, some desktop tab strips) takes the color of the page's top bar as the theme or mode changes.

title: Theme quick pick
description: The theme commands and their quick pick, and the command that turns Scroll to zoom on or off.

title: Theme editor
description: The Appearance popover, with the mode, Scroll to zoom and the themes, and the theme editor panel.

title: Desktop title bar
description: In the desktop app, the 38 px bar across the top of the window in the shell color, with room for the window's controls, back and forward, a command center naming the page that opens quick find, and the nav and chat toggles; it drags the window and is not drawn in a browser.

title: Theme to window chrome
description: In the desktop app, sends the shown theme's `--shell` and `--ink` colors to the window whenever the theme, the mode or the system's appearance changes, so the native window controls match the theme.

title: Window title bar options
description: In the desktop shell's main process, a window with no system title bar: the macOS traffic lights centered in the app's 38 px bar, or on Windows and Linux the native controls as an overlay in the theme's colors, which are checked before they reach the window.

title: Native menus
description: The desktop app's native menus: the app menu on a Mac (About Lathe, Settings…), File, Edit, View with the record tabs, Window and Help; app commands carry no accelerator so their keys reach the app's keymap, except Settings (Cmd+,), Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab.

title: Shell pages
description: The launch view, the error page and the About window.

title: Dock icon and menu
description: On macOS, the Dock badge with the number of check errors in the focused window's product (none at 0, "999+" past 999), and the Dock menu's New Window above the recent folders.

title: DomainWiki
description: A domain's wiki page, read in the stages and folders of the side nav, and the stage sections it shares with the Product page's Shared section.

title: Markdown
description: Renders Markdown to sanitized HTML, giving each heading an anchor and turning named record IDs into in-app links; a code block scrolls sideways in its own focusable box.

title: Graph page
description: The Graph stage: the product's tree as one fixed map drawn on a canvas in the Tree, Nested or Voronoi view, explored by a camera that glides to frame the focus, with a hidden keyboard layer of its boxes and its controls in the shared stage toolbar.

title: RecordFrame
description: What every record's page holds around its aggregate's own content (the Record page pattern): a test's note when it is not automated yet, its Traceability, its problems, and its facts (kind, stage, a test's state, why it has no parent, its data file) and links both ways, from the space's record summaries.

title: Long list
description: A list that stays short: up to ten items a plain list; past that, the first ten rows' height scrolling inside, under a search box with a count ("12 of 48") and a message when nothing matches.

title: Focus page
description: The stage and the panels floating over it, for one focus.

title: Nav
description: The side navigation: the space rail when there are two or more products, then the current space's panel (Go to, its overview and stages, its domains folded into stages and folders, its groups, and Tools with Checks) and a footer with Appearance and where the specs come from; it collapses to the rail, or is a drawer on a narrow screen.

title: Quick open
description: Quick find and the command palette in one overlay, with the stage's preview of the highlighted record.

title: Tree list
description: A list whose rows each fold one level of nested rows under a disclosure triangle, keeping the row's count and marks when folded; a search opens a row just for its match, the arrow keys walk it as a tree, and what is open is remembered for the session.
